query: What do Google Pixel 3 XL reviews say about screen clarity, brightness, and touchscreen reliability?
search_text: What do reviews say about screen clarity, brightness, and touchscreen reliability?

rows.text: Wait for the pixel 4. The device looked new with no scratches. Unfortunately, the screen was misaligned, screen brightness fluctuates constantly, and the bottom speaker is blown. Lastly, when trying to use the best feature (camera) it flashes to a black screen after opening the camera app.

Battery life is enough to last all day in one charge. Bluetooth is reliable and pairs easily with most speakers, headphones etc. Negative: Storage is just barely enough, have to manage apps delete unused ones etc. No dedicated headphone jack the charging port is also used for headphones The camera does not zoom enough it tops out at 7x zoom "Night" does nothing to improve night time pictures. Video tops out at a mere 2x zoom. No telephoto lens or macro on camera although closeups do come out very good, it would be nice to have a dedicated mode for it . Screen gets washed out in bright sunlight, an automatic sunlight adjustment would be nice. This photo was taken with the pixels camera, in non-night mode with a about a 3x zoom., at closer zooms there was more blurring around the moon.
Good as a second phone. What I like: It’s a Pixel What I didn’t like (about this Pixel sad Sometimes the touchscreen doesn’t register touch inputs on the lower right of the screen.

It becomes a tiny bit larger - like a few more pixels - when Adaptive is selected. Natural and boosted remove that pink tint, but otherwise there's no difference between them. And none of them make a dent in the cigarette smoke colored screen. Turning on nightlight is really impressive. Everything kind of goes into a cinnamon colored sepia tone. I'm not the only person this has happened to. There are lots of side-by-side photos showing a normal phone vs the Pixel 3 xl. And before you say "You're just used to a screen with more blue in it... " no. Seriously. I know some screens are more blue or less blue. THIS screen is dingy, muted... right out of the box it looks like it was used hard by a Kirkland brand Meeseeks. (That's for all you Rick and Morty fans out there).

Screen Scratched pretty good, wasn't able to see in the picture.. I am very happy with the phone. I thought it was perfect until I saw the deep scratches in the screen. It's not a big deal to me, but it might be to you. Phone works just fine. I little hard to get used to after having Samsung for so many years. I like a lot of features it has. Like CALL SCREENING... and turn it face down to DO NOT Disturb. Oct. 12 2020. after having the phone for awhile, I have to say I hate it. It is so much harder to use than Samsung. Photos don't impress me either. the double tap on the screen to wake it up never works. the double click on the power button rarely brings up the camera. Google photos sucks so bad I can't explain it. I hate this pixel phone to no end.
Screen faults. In general, the phone is fine, but there is a big problem and that is that the screen has faults and flashes
no sign of usage at all. mild screen imprinting at the top, not noticeable at all

Does What it is Supposed to Do Without Instability, Good Camera. I upgraded from a Pixel 2 because I wanted the larger screen. (However, the screen isn't that much larger.). The Pixel 3 XL seems to be faster and it just feels like it works a little better. The camera is as good or better than the Pixel 2 -- really both are great. My romantic friend migrated from an iPhone to a Pixel 3a XL, and she says she likes it. If money is an issue, I would say the 3a XL is slightly better in bang per buck.

Great Phone. Pixel 3XL is a great value at this price. Phone came in mint condition with no issues. I already got the new Android 10 that was released. The camera takes amazing pictures and still have 2 years of unlimited Google photo storage with pictures and videos taken on this phone and 2 years of guaranteed updates. Only 2 knocks on this phone, 1 is the battery life. It's not the best and have to charge it several times throughout the daymb 2 is the screen brightness. This is a very dim panel. It's great, but I keep the phone on 100% brightness to have the best display. Anything under 70% is too dim unless you're indoors.

Photo - nice, battery - not nice.. Pixel is an iPhone in the android world. I have been using Apple products for a long time. And the only thing this phone [pixel 3 XL] upset me with is the PWM in the backlight adjustment. At a brightness below 75%, the screen flickers and it hurts my eyes. (I do not use brightness auto-adjustment now!) The second - is the battery. If you turn on everything you can, you need to recharge during the day. I bought a REnew phone for $ 310 and consider it a great price. I do not need two SIM cards, although 64GB is probably not enough. (But Google gives you an unlimited storage for photos and videos made by the phone in its original quality until January 31, 2022).

GREAT SCREEN, CAMERA, BATTERY, STORAGE + DURABLE!. I've had the Google pixel 3XL for several months now and have really enjoyed it; this may even be my favorite phone thus far (and I've had 6 phones over the last 2 years, most being major flagship models). It feels super thin and lightweight, but SUPER durable - my screen is scratch-free (and I don't use a screen protector!), and this phone has survived not just getting dropped A LOT - after missing for 4 days, it was found outside under bricks after days of storms! I wiped the mud off, plugged it in and it worked perfectly (and still does!). The 6.3 inch screen is big, bright and vibrant, with excellent screen-to-body ratio. I've gotten used to the black "notch" that drops down about half an inch at the top because it allows for a great ear speaker and an awesome front camera.
Questionable reliability?. After a little over a year the camera quit focusing. It was out of warranty of course. Known problem with this phone.

As Good as Advertised. My phone just came in within an hour. It's refurbished but looked brand new, no visible flaws. The charging port feels solid and has that "like new" snap to it. All basic features of the phone perform as they should. No real review on the phone yet, but the phone arrived and functions as advertised for a refurbished phone from this seller. Initial feel of the phone coming from a Pixel 1 XL is that it's definitely bigger, screen is an improvement but it still has all of the comforts of a Google phone. If anything changes I'll update my review.

Googles previous flagship holds it own in 2021. Google knocks it out the part. Oodles of ram, bright/sharp screen and fantastic battery life. It automatically just updated to android 11. The camera and the software are top tier. This pixel 3XL is still a phone to beat for 2021 without the burden of a heavy price tag. Definitely worth your consideration.

Avoid "Renewed" Listings From This Company. I debated writing this review for a few weeks, as I'm not usually the type to do so; however, I felt the need to bolster the negative reviews of this company. When I received my Pixel 3 XL, I was initially worried over burn in of the screen at the top near the notification bar. Regardless, everything worked... Until it didn't. This started with the Bluetooth, GPS, and WiFi not working sporadically. A full system reset fixed this for a couple of months. Then, my phone start randomly bootlooping (I could have my phone sitting next to me and it would suddenly bootloop). Another factory reset fixed this as well. Eventually, the bootlooping issue came back. This time, it would often lead to an error reading "Can't read Android system". This wasn't exactly a huge deal, as selecting "continue" simply lead to a factory reset.

Buyers Beware. I got my Pixel 3 XL from Tech Exchangee. This product is supposed to undergo "rigorous testing by trained and certified technicians." I wonder where they got their certification, anyone with an eye can spot a black dot on a white screen. I tried to search what this dot was, looks different than most dead pixels or screen burn ins. Regardless, it won't go away and I have requested a replacement. Quite the hassle for the customer to have to return what is expected to be a flawless renewed device. If I get a replacement, I'll update this review.

Screen scratches. Headache using it for sprint.. The phone has screen surface scratches which is a disappointment. Comes with charger no booklet or headphones. Bought this to use for sprint. Contact customer service online first. The people at the store told me it would not work. Cs online says it takes 72hrs to authenticate then I can use it. Hopefully I can use the phone soon.

Good deal. Small scratch in upper right corner of screen. Can't even see it when the screen is in though so not really a big deal. Phone is lightning fast, takes amazing photos, and has pretty good battery life especially when battery saver is turned on.

Great. The reviews that I had read made me and my husband very nervous! However the phones are great! We did receive phones where each had 1 little scuff on the bumper, but that is covered now with a case. The screens are perfect and the phone functions beautifuly. We did receive generic chargers even though the seller says you get pixel chargers. That doesn't bother us, as they still charge the phone. It comes in a generic box, and the phone is in a zip lock type bag that is then in plastic wrap... won't lie seemed VERY sketchy when I opened it, however like I said the phones are perfect minus the one scuff on the bumper.

Works but wondering if renewed has lesser cheaper glass screen. Renewed by Amazon. Works fine in my metro PC's/TMobile just had to take it in to get activated. But wondering if the screen is really cornings gorilla glass. First cleaning with eyeglass cloth scratched the screen deeply ? I usually don't like the add on screen protectors as they don't seem to hold up ever. But ,a bit surprised and sad the screen is now etched from cleaning it.
